questions.explain: The reliable pattern is range partitioning by time, with this workflow: ALTER TABLE...SWITCH PARTITION to a staging table (metadata-only, instant, no data movement), export the staging table to S3 as Parquet/CSV, verify via checksum + row count (e.g., Athena count), then drop the staging table and MERGE the partition boundary. Record everything in an archive_metadata tracking table.

questions.explain: Apply S3 lifecycle policies: Standard → Standard-IA at 30 days → Glacier Instant (GLACIER_IR) at 90 days → Deep Archive at 365 days, with deletion of expired archives (e.g., 2555 days for audit events). A nightly scheduler finds partitions older than the cold threshold (e.g., 6 months), exports to Parquet, verifies, and switches them out — automation runs forever, manual archival runs once.
